name: via-bimanual-cam
description: via-bimanual-cam: the 21 VIA tools with right/left arm semantics plus gripper_home (joint-space return of either arm to its start pose), camera_views (gallery of every selectable camera), camera_feed_select (sticky 3rd-person feed switch), and camera_raw (any single camera at native render fidelity).
source: interfaces/via_cam subclassed with dual-arm wording (via_cam.py links to its tools.py)
